## What it is

The piece between levels. A disk clamps the lap under it. A pin carries the next cross. Print it socket down.

## Design notes

- Seating face to seating face is one pitch, 23 mm. The web between the two hubs is 9 mm, because each hub is 14 mm of the 23.
- The socket is the same diamond as the cross hole. It closes with a 45° pyramid so there is no bridged ceiling. The pyramid stops 0.8 mm across, inside the pin, so the mesh stays closed.
- The 0.2 mm across-flats clearance is a design choice. Print the fit coupon before a stack of these.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 0.8
```

## Don't

- Don't print the socket facing up. The cone is the roof only when the socket is on the bed.
- Don't lengthen the web without lengthening the pitch. The next level would leave the helix.

## Changelog
